bph: BPH means the same as benign prostatic hyperplasia.
bpi: A bpi is a measure of how densely information is packed on a storage medium.
Bpi means the same as bits per inch.
bpm: A bpm is the pace of music measured by the number of beats occurring in 60 seconds.
Bpm means the same as beats per minute or metronome marking or M.M..
bps: Bps is the rate at which data is transferred.
Bps means the same as bits per second.
